tldr: Neptune through the 1st house blurs your body, identity, confidence, and first response to life.
body:
When Neptune moves through your 1st house, it blurs the edges of your body, identity, energy, appearance, confidence, and the way you show up. You may feel more aware of how you are coming across, how much energy you have, and whether your outer life still matches who you feel yourself becoming.

Longing, sensitivity, confusion, compassion, avoidance, or idealization may be stronger. It can help you soften where life has become too rigid or overly defended.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for noticing what your presence is already saying before you explain anything.

The caution: Watch for believing the dream so completely that you stop checking the evidence. The risk is becoming too focused on how you are perceived and missing what your body is telling you.

Neptune moves through this house for a long chapter. Keep the sensitivity, but stay honest about what is actually happening.
